19. | RESOLUTION - For naming the median which contains the Historic Airport Fountain,
located to the east of the intersection of Central Avenue and East 8" Avenue, to be known
as Airport Fountain Park. (SPONSOR — MR. LAYBOURN)

Mr. Laybourn moved to adopt, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried with Mr. Laybourn and
Dr. Rinne voting “YES” and Mr. Segrave voting “NO”.

Following the motion being made, Chairman Cook excused himself from the meeting at 12:36
p.m. and relinquished the chair to Dr. Rinne who voted as the chairman to break the tie.

Lonnie Olson, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report. Charles Bloom,
Planning & Development Department Director, and Jason Sanchez, Community Recreation &
Events Director, provided additional information. Committee members Laybourn, Rinne, and
Segrave commented on the item and public comment was made by Don Harrold, Historic
Preservation Board, and Michael White.

Mr. Cook rejoined the meeting at 12:40 p.m, following the vote on item #19 and prior to officially
adjourning the meeting.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Public Services Committee, the
meeting was adjourned at 12:40 p.m.

Submitted by,

Qunlilleadt

Jennifer McClelland
Executive Assistant to the Cheyenne City Council
